help.description: List available commands or show detailed command help
help.commandAccepted: A command suggested by autocomplete, such as `roll`
help.title: Command Help
help.available: Commands currently available to you. Use `/help command:<command>` for details.
help.behavior: Without an option, lists the commands available to the current user and groups them by category. With `command`, displays the selected command’s permission, parameters, accepted values, examples, and behavior.

permissions.dm: Configured DM role or server owner; owner-only when the role is omitted
permissions.moderator: Configured moderator role or server owner; owner-only when the role is omitted

accepted.autocomplete: Select or enter a value; autocomplete provides valid suggestions
accepted.autocompleteComplete: All {{count}} available values are listed below. Type part of a name or value to filter autocomplete.
accepted.numberMinimum: A number greater than or equal to {{min}}
accepted.numberMaximum: A number less than or equal to {{max}}

purge.description: Delete recent messages from the current channel
purge.amount: Number of recent messages to delete
purge.behavior: Deletes the requested number of recent messages from the current channel. Discord bulk deletion restrictions still apply.

reload.description: Reload supported runtime state and reconnect to Discord
reload.behavior: Reloads and validates configuration and English/French localizations, clears generator caches, rebuilds the in-memory command registry, refreshes Discord slash-command registration, cleans up active voice/audio resources, and reconnects the existing Discord client without terminating Node.js. Failed stages are reported while previous valid state is retained where practical. Source-code, startup, event-routing, mechanics, and model changes still require manually restarting `node index.js`.

say.description: Send a message through the bot
say.behavior: Posts the supplied message in the current channel through the bot.

add.description: Create a blank character or creature with a stable EntityKey
add.keyOption: Unique entity save key; make it short and memorable
add.success: {{type}} with key `{{key}}` was created. This EntityKey and type cannot be changed. Use `/set` with a compatible field to open its prefilled private form.
add.behavior: Creates and saves a blank entity owned by the invoking user. `type` accepts `character` or `creature` and defaults to `character`. EntityKeys are globally unique across both types, must start and end with a letter or number, and may contain internal periods, hyphens, and underscores.

damage.description: Deal damage to an entity, reducing AR before HP
damage.entityOption: Character or creature receiving the damage
damage.amountOption: Positive amount of damage to deal
damage.piercingOption: Bypass AR and deal the damage directly to HP
damage.piercingBreakdown: {{amount}} piercing damage was dealt directly to {{hpLabel}}.
damage.normalBreakdown: {{arDamage}} damage was absorbed by {{arLabel}} and {{hpDamage}} damage reached {{hpLabel}}.
damage.behavior: Applies a positive whole-number damage amount to the selected character or creature's current AR first, then current HP. When `piercing` is true, damage bypasses AR. Only the entity creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

delete.description: Permanently delete an entity and all retained backups
delete.entityOption: Character or creature to permanently delete
delete.warning:
## Permanent deletion
This removes the active save and every retained backup for `{{key}}`. `/undo` cannot restore it.
delete.confirmationDescription: The value is case-sensitive and must match the EntityKey shown above.
delete.incorrectConfirmation: The confirmation did not exactly match `{{key}}`. Nothing was deleted. Run `/delete` again to retry.
delete.expired: This deletion confirmation is missing or expired. Run `/delete` again.
delete.wrongUser: This deletion confirmation belongs to another user.
delete.success: Entity **{{key}}** and all retained backups were permanently deleted.
delete.operationFailed: The entity and its retained backups could not be deleted safely. Nothing was intentionally left partially deleted.
delete.behavior: Opens a private confirmation form. Type the exact, case-sensitive EntityKey to permanently delete both the active character or creature save and every retained backup. This cannot be undone. Only the entity creator, a DM, or the server owner may confirm deletion.

endTurn.description: Restore current AP and MD to their maximum values
endTurn.entityOption: Character or creature ending its turn
endTurn.behavior: Restores the selected character or creature's current AP and MD to their respective maximum values. Only the entity creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

gen.description: Generate GM inspiration (configured DM role or server owner)
gen.schemaDescription: Generate GM inspiration from a chosen category
gen.modifierOption: Optional modifier source configured for the selected category
gen.unknownCategory: Unknown generator category: **{{category}}**. Use `/help command:gen` for command details.
gen.invalidModifier: Modifier source **{{modifier}}** is not configured for category **{{category}}**.
gen.title: Generated {{category}}
gen.behavior: Resolves one weighted result from the chosen localized public generator, then displays each configured automatic modifier as a separate result. Inline references and modifier relationships share a maximum nesting depth of four and preserve technical provenance. The optional modifier source must be declared by the selected category; choosing it generates it once regardless of its automatic percentage.

genChar.description: Generate a random character (configured DM role or server owner)
genChar.schemaDescription: Generate and save a complete random character
genChar.keyOption: Unique save key, make it short and remember it.
genChar.levelOption: Character level; omitted means a random level from 1 to 10
genChar.backgroundOption: Character background; omitted means a random background
genChar.behavior: Creates and saves a complete random character under a unique CharacterKey. Level must be 1–10 and is random when omitted; background is also optional and random by default. The public `background` router selects an internal detail catalog and may attach shared descriptive modifiers. A shared statistical profile allocates statistics, while resources, RULEs, armor, weapons, inventory, gold, and possible status effects follow the selected level and game rules. Encumbrance remains manual and defaults to 0 / 0.

genMonster.description: Generate a creature (configured DM role or server owner)
genMonster.schemaDescription: Generate and save a complete random creature
genMonster.levelOption: Creature level; randomly 1 to 10 when omitted
genMonster.success: Generated **{{name}}** and saved it with CreatureKey `{{key}}`.
genMonster.behavior: Atomically creates and saves one complete creature by routing the selected `monster`, `animal`, or `companion` type through the public `creature` catalog to its internal `creature_*` detail catalog. The CreatureKey is globally unique and level must be 1–10 or is random when omitted. Shared statistical profiles allocate statistics and derive resources; RULEs are granted only by explicit source references. Initial status effects and modifiers come from the same descriptive catalogs available to characters, while equipment, inventory, natural armor, and armor metadata are resolved and persisted with stable provenance. Encumbrance remains manual and defaults to 0 / 0. Only a configured DM or the server owner may use this command.

get.description: Display an entity summary or one compatible detailed field
get.unknownField: That field is not available for this entity: **{{field}}**. Use `/help command:get` for command details.
get.behavior: Without `field`, posts the public entity summary. Character fields use `name`, `level`, `status`, `statistics`, `rules`, `talents`, `gear`, `race`, `background`, `personality`, and `modifiers`, in that order. Creature fields use the independent order `identity`, `level`, `status`, `statistics`, `rules`, `traits`, `modifiers`, and `gear`. Status effects and descriptive modifiers are available to both entity types. Autocomplete shows only fields compatible with the selected EntityKey.

heal.description: Restore current HP, armor, or both to a percentage of maximum
heal.entityOption: Character or creature receiving the healing
heal.percentageOption: Percentage of the maximum to restore to
heal.behavior: Sets a character or creature's current HP, current AR, or both to the requested percentage of each resource's own maximum, using the shared rounding rule. Only the entity creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

roll.behavior: Rolls one standard dice group using `COUNTdSIDES`, optionally followed by one signed modifier, for example `1d20`, `2d6+3`, or `4d8-2`. Count must be 1–100, sides 2–1,000, and the absolute modifier at most 10,000. Multiple dice groups, parentheses, and other arithmetic are unsupported. Exact `1d2` and `1d20` rolls return their dedicated GIF; other expressions return a textual breakdown.

errors.invalidFormat: Invalid dice expression. Use `COUNTdSIDES` with one optional modifier, for example `2d6+3`.
errors.diceCount: The dice count must be between 1 and {{maxDice}}.
errors.diceSides: The number of sides must be between 2 and {{maxSides}}.
errors.modifier: The modifier must be between -{{maxModifier}} and +{{maxModifier}}.

rules.behavior: Replies with the public URL for the TTRPG rulebook.

set.description: Set one compatible entity field group in a prefilled form
set.behavior: Opens one private modal prefilled for the selected entity type. Character groups retain their established order with `modifiers` appended; creature groups use `identity`, `level`, `status`, `statistics`, `rules`, `traits`, `modifiers`, and `gear`, with identity editing Name and Description. Descriptive modifiers use one `Name:Description` record per line for both types. Creature traits and creature status effects use that same record format, while character status effects retain their compatible plain line-based format. Statistics, RULE, gear, resources, and encumbrance keep their compatible shared formats. EntityKey, type, schema metadata, source IDs, natural-armor metadata, and provenance are never editable. Every group is validated and saved atomically as one undoable operation. Only the entity creator, a DM, or the server owner may edit it.

undo.description: Restore the newest retained pre-change entity snapshot
undo.entityOption: Character or creature whose newest backup will be restored
undo.success: Restored entity `{{key}}`. The **{{action}}** backup created {{timestamp}} by {{actor}} was consumed.
undo.behavior: Restores and consumes the newest available backup for an active character or creature without changing its type. Successful `/set`, `/damage`, `/heal`, and `/end-turn` operations save the complete pre-change entity state. The current `characterHistory.maxEntries` limit applies to both types. Repeated undos walk backward; redo is unsupported, and permanent `/delete` removes all backups. Only the entity creator, a DM, or the server owner may use it.

errors.noHistory: No backup is available for that entity.
errors.invalidBackup: The newest entity backup is invalid and cannot be restored.
errors.unsupportedSchema: The newest entity backup uses an unsupported save schema and cannot be restored.
errors.operationFailed: The entity and its history could not be updated safely. No retry was attempted.

editor.tooLarge: This field is larger than Discord’s 4,000-character modal limit.

editor.rulesDescription: One RULE per line: Name:Level:Description. All three values are required.
editor.describedDescription: One record per line: Name:Description. Both values are required.
editor.collectionDescription: One entry per line; blank lines are ignored. Empty the form to clear.
editor.textDescription: The previous value is prefilled. Empty the form to clear it.
editor.equipmentDescription: One equipment entry per line. Empty the input to clear equipment.
editor.inventoryDescription: One inventory entry per line. Empty the input to clear inventory.
editor.statisticsDescription: One `statName: value` line per statistic; all nine English names are required.
editor.statisticsPlaceholder: One line per statistic: statName: value
